title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Credit for Partial Claim Repayments on Restoration by Substitution
content:
When a seller's VA Home Loan Guaranty entitlement is restored by substitution, the seller receives a repayment credit for partial claim repayments received on the loan, read from the partial claim repayment entries in the loan's money transactions and their dates.

## The credit

| Partial claim repayments on the loan | Credit |
|---|---|
| A repayment received within the 24 months before today | The recent-credit percentage, 50 percent, of all partial claim repayments received on the loan |
| Repayments received, but none within the 24 months before today | The older-credit percentage, 25 percent, of all partial claim repayments received on the loan |
| No repayment received | Nothing |

The credit window is 24 months. The percentage applies to the total of the partial claim repayments received on the loan, whatever their dates; the dates decide only which percentage applies.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Repayments on the loan | Latest repayment (months before today) | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 6,000.00 in total | 4 | 6,000.00 multiplied by 50 and divided by one hundred, or 3,000.00 |
| 6,000.00 in total | 30 | 6,000.00 multiplied by 25 and divided by one hundred, or 1,500.00 |
| None | — | Nothing |
